author: assistant session at the owner's request (2026-11-20: run the pending fp64 diagnostic and complete the gate); owner acceptance pending through the review of PR #24
reason: The 7B end-to-end equivalence of the diagnostic contract stock_fp64 (oracle10 vs the M9 oracle9 capture) was the only campaign step not run: attempts 1 and 2 were BLOCKED by the host start check (blocked-O7-stock_fp64*.json) and attempt 3 was stopped by the operator while waiting for GO, with no record.

On 2026-11-20 the owner asked to complete it. O7-stock_fp64-a3 ran under the unchanged step of tools/campaign10_sequence.sh (official start check GO, 6 GiB scope, swap 0, oom 0) and campaign/equivalence-7b-e2e-stock_fp64.json was written by the unchanged tools/equivalence10_e2e.py: logits, residuals and K/V bit-identical to oracle9 (verdict PASS, coverage FULL).

Until now tools/report_increment10.py did not read the 7B diagnostic. This amendment adds, only when an O7-stock_fp64 attempt has a run record: (F) 7b_e2e.stock_fp64.reported_raw = recomputation from the capture files equals the stored comparison, both captures bound (oracle10 to the run record, oracle9 to results/increment9/capture-manifest.json), verdict PASS or FAIL, no identity problem; (G) the latest O7-stock_fp64 and O14-stock_fp64 attempts are supervised like the gating oracles (6 GiB). The facts of F now also list the raw 7B equivalence of all three contracts.

The diagnostic can only contradict F or G, never make them pass: without a run record (absent or BLOCKED) no check is added, so the verdict rules of the preregistered contracts are unchanged. e2e_recomputed additionally checks the stored input digests and the empty problem list also for the gating contracts (tightening).

The previous final suite, inventory verification and gate outputs are kept with suffix -a4 / -a2 (campaign/pytest-final-a4.*, inventory-verify-final-a4.json, gate10-a2.json, gate10-mutations-a2.json).

not_verifiable_on_runner.cause: tests/test_increment9_hardening.py "-real" cases need the local unsanitized M9 originals, which are deliberately not in Git (sanitization of increment 9)

ci_runner_verification.rule: runner verdict PASS = every runner-verifiable required test passed, nothing missing, extra or duplicated, and each declared test either passed or was skipped with exactly the declared message; such a skip is NOT VERIFIABLE ON RUNNER and keeps the full-inventory verdict of the runner at NOT PROVEN. The archived local attestation must be a full PASS of the same inventory with its pinned JUnit SHA256. CI succeeds only if both hold.
